scope: One fresh permutation per scored actor decision, shared by that decision's stack rows. Only added feature columns are permuted; source/target nodes and source/target embeddings are unchanged.
generator: Fisher-Yates with rejection-sampled SplitMix64 draws from separate per-seat policy streams, reset for each game; no game-state RNG reads and no sampler-stream draws.
replay: Capture the complete column permutation with the raw validated rows. Absent permutation means identity and preserves all prior serialized rows.
limitations: Retains the feature-value multiset, counts, graph bindings, source/target embeddings, and legacy hashed inputs. Not a no-information control. A fixed permutation would be learnably invertible and is not used.
